objective: Verify against the live catalogue whether the Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ wood/drywall screw line includes a variant with screw type wood screw, diameter 6 mm, and length 120 mm, and report YES/NO with the checked SKU.

params.base_product: lookup base product from product_variants WHERE brand normalized-matches 'Heco' AND series/line normalized-matches a short 'TopFix GTU-YPJ' / wood-and-drywall-screw token (LOWER/TRIM + LIKE on a minimal token); SELECT product_sku, record_path; bind base = first matching row
params.extra_claim_holds: for $base.product_sku, test via product_variant_properties (and product_variants) whether the claimed extra properties all hold: screw type = wood screw AND diameter = 6 mm AND length = 120 mm

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Base product found (SKU {checked_sku}); claimed variant (wood screw / 6 mm / 120 mm) {YES_NO}. <NO> with checked SKU when base exists but extra claim absent; <YES> with SKU when present; <NO> when base absent.
